title: Crestline Fleet Account Late Charge Terms
content:
Late charges on a Crestline Fleet Account are assessed at month-end on what is past due.

## Retired clause

> At each month-end the past-due balance (the open amount of every invoice whose due date is before the last day of the month, plus unpaid late charges, as of that day) is charged the program's monthly late-charge percent, rounded half up to the cent, and never less than the program's smallest late charge when any past-due balance exists.

This clause is **no longer in force**. It is superseded by the current month-end late charge basis.

## Clauses in force

1. **One charge per statement month.** Only one late charge may be assessed for each statement month. Whether a month already carries one is read from the account's own late charge entries for that statement month, before a charge is booked.
2. **When no late charge is assessed.** No late charge is assessed when nothing is past due, on a program whose monthly late-charge percent is 0, or on an amount under an open invoice dispute.
3. **Public Sector.** A Crestline Fleet Public Sector account is never charged late charges, because it is invoiced under the agency's own prompt-payment schedule; questions about an agency's own prompt-payment interest are not decided by this charter.

## Points of judgement

| Situation | Late charge for the month |
|---|---|
| a late charge is already booked for that statement month | no second charge for that month |
| nothing past due at month-end | none |
| program's monthly late-charge percent is 0 | none |
| the amount concerned is under an open invoice dispute | none on that amount |
| Crestline Fleet Public Sector account | none |

superseded_clauses: At each month-end the past-due balance (fleet_msr_past_due_balance as of the last day of the month, late_charge_basis) is charged late_charge_monthly_pct percent, rounded half up to the cent, and never less than late_charge_min when any past-due balance exists.
